digest.component_or_area: plan-review and code-review gates, criteria snapshot kernel, provider integration
propositions: The cutover must enforce that review gates use a single centralized CriteriaSnapshot and never read packaged/project routing directly, verified by a repository-policy contract guard that fails on prohibited direct-reader patterns.

A deterministic shadow comparator must consume the same call/result set as both legacy and RP-06 projections, report field-level mismatches, and accept only approved deltas (built-in retune/disable, project DET inclusion, project LLM applicability, code-review budget enforcement, typed partial-failure continuation, success-only checkpointing).

The public response schemas (review-plan, review-plan --status, code-review) must remain narrow while their reducer-ignored journals retain versioned internal traces; new code must ignore legacy checkpoints and the retained legacy projection must not write new journal envelopes.

A live provider canary must exercise the real default discovery path against all configured external providers, prove at least one discovery call reaches each provider, assert a narrow final verdict (PASS/BLOCK) and retained internal journal, and print no secrets, prompts, or traces.

Rollback is defined as a code revert to the retained compatibility projection with no journal rewrite, operator configuration flag, or data cleanup required; final ownership of snapshot/executor/gate/RP-01 must be documented in docs/review-kernel.md.
No second discovery scheduler outside the shared kernel may be introduced, and per-unit trace/debug fields must not enter review or review-status output schemas.
